provenance.sourceText: Let the villagers handle organizing the festival, instead of me.

semantics.seedReserve: Keeps this many grain in the shared bakery from NPC festival collection, and in the player bag from gifts/donations. Planting may use player seeds; NPC-owned gifts remain usable.
semantics.venue: A prepared or announced festival keeps its venue; a changed venue applies to the next festival.
semantics.revert: Prospective rule restoration. Historical undo requires rewind and fork.
semantics.flood: Blocks movement in the authored low-path zone; existing occupants get safe egress. Fixed-step TTL.
